text:
Alex (Sales): Quick heads-up — EmberCorp wants to move forward with a POC but they have a long enterprise checklist. Main asks: SSO (SAML), SCIM user + group sync, RBAC mapping to roles, domain ownership proofing, and a security questionnaire. They also asked for a pricing comparison: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. Can SE/security/infra chime in with a short POC plan and ballpark pricing?

Priya (SE): +1. Can run the technical POC. Suggested approach: 1) verify SAML login + role assertion, 2) SCIM user sync (incremental + delta), 3) RBAC mapping validation (3 roles), 4) audit/logging verification. Acceptance criteria: successful SSO login, 50 users synced (with groups), roles applied on sign-in, and audit events visible in the console. I can do the run in a sandbox account. Need EmberCorp to provide: IdP metadata, SCIM base URL + auth creds for test account, list of example users & groups, and their security questionnaire PDF. Timeline: 10-14 business days if infra is ready.

Alex (Sales): They specifically require: on-prem/private deployment option (no egress for SCIM?), HSM/KMS for keys, and 1yr contract for dedicated throughput if we go that route. Also security team requested audit log retention of 1 year and cert rotation process.

Marta (Security): High-level: we can support all of those but with trade-offs. Private (customer-managed plane) supports KMS/HSM integration and full VPC isolation — preferred for strict data residency. Audit logs: Hosted has 90 days by default; we can offer extended retention as an add-on (enterprise plan). SAML: we support signed assertions and SP-initiated flows. SCIM calls must be TLS1.2+, mutual TLS available for Private. For the questionnaire, please upload the PDF to the support portal (https://support.redwood.ai/upload) and tag me — I'll run through it and return a redacted export we can share.

Tom (Infra): For the POC infra notes: if EmberCorp wants no internet egress for user data, we need Private (on-prem or VPC). Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) is network-connected but can be restricted by allowlists and private peering. SCIM specifics: we support standard /Users and /Groups endpoints with support for incremental filtering by "lastModified". For large customer syncs we recommend batching of 100 users per request. For onboarding test we can spin up a Dedicated sandbox in ~3 business days; Private deployment lead time is ~3-4 weeks (ops + infra + contract).

Priya (SE): SCIM mapping example — share with EmberCorp IdP team. Paste this into their SCIM connector config:

```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "externalId": "{employeeId}",
  "userName": "{email}",
  "name": {
    "givenName": "{firstName}",
    "familyName": "{lastName}"
  },
  "emails": [{"value": "{email}", "primary": true}],
  "groups": ["engineering", "admin"]
}
```

Also mapping for group-to-role (in our console): group claim = 'redwood_groups' or use SCIM groups sync and map in Console -> RBAC -> Role mappings.

Evan (Product): Quick product notes: we have role templates for admin/developer/viewer. You can map SAML assertions (e.g., attribute "roles") or map SCIM groups to those templates. Domain controls: we support domain locking for orgs (requires TXT record proof) and optional federation back to IdP for invite flows. For audit proofing, we'll provide JSON export of events (login, token issuance, SCIM events) for the retention window agreed in contract.

Alex (Sales): Pricing ask from EmberCorp: they want a ballpark for a 1yr commit for Dedicated and a one-time Professional Services quote for Private install + KMS integration. Any ranges?

Priya (SE): Ballpark (very rough): Hosted: pay-as-you-go — negligible setup (not relevant for their use-case). Dedicated: ~$25k-$60k/month depending on committed GPU capacity and SLA tier (this is a wide range — depends on throughput). Private: platform license + PS — typical initial engagement $150k-$350k for on-prem + 1st-year support, then annual platform fee. We should loop in sales ops for exact numbers and legal. Discounts for 12mo prepay typically 10-25% depending on commit.

Marta (Security): From questionnaire perspective: common blockers we see: 1) network egress/data leakage (solved by Private), 2) key custody (we need KMS/HSM details), 3) multi-tenant metadata separation (we provide per-customer isolation in Private/Dedicated), 4) cert rotation and SAML signing keys — we support automated rotation and manual rotation processes. If EmberCorp requires an on-site audit or additional SOC reports, that'll affect PS costs.

Tom (Infra): For the POC I can provision a Dedicated sandbox and a Private test node (lightweight) for connectivity tests. Action items: EmberCorp to provide IdP metadata and a SCIM test account; Alex to upload the customer security questionnaire PDF to support; Priya to schedule the POC run; Marta to start questionnaire review.

Alex (Sales): I'll upload the questionnaire now and schedule the Wed demo (10:00 PT). Attendees: EmberCorp Sec + IT, me, Priya, Tom, Marta. Evan — can you join the product demo for the RBAC/domains part?

Evan (Product): Yep, I'll join Wed. Priya — ping me if you want a quick sync before.

Priya (SE): I'll own the technical POC run. Tom will set up infra. Marta will respond to the questionnaire. I'll prepare a checklist doc and send EmberCorp a minimal config guide before Wed (SAML metadata + SCIM sample + test users). :thumbsup:

Alex (Sales): Perfect. I'll share the questionnaire link in the thread once uploaded. Thanks all. :rocket:
